name: ePlaneAI
summary: AI platform for parts suppliers and MROs: inbox AI that reads RFQs and drafts quotes, plus demand forecasting, reorder and slow-mover analysis.
paragraphs: AI platform for parts suppliers and MROs: inbox AI that reads RFQs and drafts quotes, plus demand forecasting, reorder and slow-mover analysis.
whyItMatters: Aimed at suppliers with large, slow-moving inventories who miss RFQs buried in email.
